## Problem

Describe the user-visible problem or capability.

## Changes

Describe the implementation and any compatibility decisions.

## Validation

- [ ] Rust tests pass
- [ ] Clippy and formatting pass
- [ ] npm tests pass when launcher behavior changes
- [ ] A focused regression test covers the change
- [ ] Major functionality includes automated success, failure, and adversarial coverage
- [ ] Corpus and reporter-parity checks pass when analysis or reporting changes
- [ ] `actionlint` passes when Action or workflow files change
- [ ] Documentation is updated when user-visible behavior changes

## Safety

- [ ] No proprietary fixtures, secrets, generated reports, or build artifacts are included
- [ ] Publishing behavior is unchanged, or the release impact is explicitly documented
